description: This file defines MIDI-related constants, such as status byte masks, specific MIDI message types, and utility methods for interpreting MIDI message data, conforming to the MIDI Standard 1.0.

classes.name: MidiConstants
classes.description: A utility class providing MIDI protocol constants and static methods for processing MIDI messages.

methods.name: getBytesPerMessage
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes expected in a MIDI message based on the status byte, according to the MIDI standard.

methods.name: isAllActiveSensing
methods.description: Checks whether a segment of a MIDI message contains only Active Sensing status bytes.
